subject: compile error for model with user defined gaussian mixture distribution

messages.author: 0111ed37d2662b85
messages.subject: compile error for model with user defined gaussian mixture distribution
parts:
Many thanks to the developers and countless contributors for all the great work building this useful software.

I am trying to develop a simple Gaussian mixture model through a user-defined distribution. For now I am sharing a toy example, but I hope to use something like this as part of a larger hierarchical model. The following code produces the error "Failed to create shared library" on my mac using nimble 0.7.1:

## libraries ----
library(nimble)
## define mixture distribution ----
dgaussmix <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(x = double(0), means = double(1), ps = double(1),
                 log = integer(0, default = 0)) {
    returnType(double(0))
    Probs <- dnorm(x, means, log = 0)
    ps_norm <- ps / sum(ps)
    Prob <- inprod(Probs, ps_norm)
    if(log) return(log(Prob))
    else return(Prob)
  })
rgaussmix <- nimbleFunction(
  run = function(n = integer(0, default = 1), means = double(1), ps = double(1)) {
    returnType(double(0))
    if(n != 1) print("rgaussmix only allows n = 1; using n = 1.")
    cluster <- 0
    rankSample(ps, 1, cluster)
    return(rnorm(1, means[cluster]))
  })
## model ----
code <- nimbleCode({
  for(k in 1:K){
    mu[k] ~ dnorm(0, 1)
  }
  for(i in 1:N){
    y[i] ~ dgaussmix(mu[1:K], ps[1:K])
  }
})
N <- 1e2; K <- 3
data <- list(y = rnorm(N, mean = c(-5, 0, 5)), ps = rep(1/K, K))
constants <- list(N = N, K = K)
inits <- list(mu = rep(0, K))
model <- nimbleModel(code = code, constants = constants,
                     data = data, inits = inits, check = T)
mcmcConf <- configureMCMC(model)
mcmc <- buildMCMC(mcmcConf)
Cmodel <- compileNimble(model, showCompilerOutput = T)
Cmcmc <- compileNimble(mcmc, project = model)


The R versions of the nimbleFunctions dgaussmix and rgaussmix themselves appear to work as expected. The uncompiled samplers used by mcmc$run() work well, if slowly. I have had success implementing this model with a latent mixture component indicator variable and only nimble distributions, but as expected the mixing looks pretty bad, so I'd prefer to integrate that level of the model out.

Thanks very much for your help in finding the source of the error!

Henry

messages.author: 5fa2a363d4ddd1d1
messages.subject: Re: compile error for model with user defined gaussian mixture distribution
parts:
Hi Henry,

I think there is some sort of type mismatch in compiling the
'rankSample' call. We can look into this to figure out what precisely
is going wrong,
but from the user perspective, I think you are best off simply using
'rcat' to generate 'cluster' instead of our (somewhat convoluted)
rankSample function.

Let us know if that approach causes you any trouble.

Side note: in this case 'showCompilerOutput' output is somehow being
truncated, so we need to look into that. If you run without setting
showCompilerOutput, you should be able to then run printErrors() after
the compilation fails and actually see the details of the failure.

Chris
